m: the city, pictured as a young woman and a camp of fighters
the old family name of the Bethlehem district
the family groups that made up a tribe, like counties
marches over
the survivors left after a disaster
the night moisture that keeps plants alive in the dry months
people who read omens in clouds and birds
upright stones worshipped at shrines
wooden posts for the goddess Asherah
the deep roots of the mountains, the oldest things there are
gifts burned whole on the altar
a grain measure of about five or six gallons
use olive oil as skin lotion, a sign of good times
something people whistle at in shock
the few grapes left after the pickers are done
the first sweet figs of summer
like the muck people tread through
the Euphrates
a shepherd's club
the rich grazing land east of the Jordan
stamp down
